name: Whisper
summary: Whisper is OpenAI's open-source speech recognition model and Python package. It runs locally on CPU or GPU and handles multilingual transcription, translation to English and language identification. Model sizes range from tiny (39M parameters) to large (1.55B).
facts: tiny, base, small, medium, large, turbo
watchOut: Transcribes files; no built-in streaming mode for live voice agents
The turbo model is not trained for translation
